hero_prompt: English. A quiet, empty Korean high school classroom set up for a national exam in late autumn morning light: rows of single wooden desks with numbered paper tags taped on the corners, a single pair of ordinary eyeglasses folded on one desk, cool blue-grey window light, shot from the back corner at desk height. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no real people's faces.
